The competitive balance stems from Howard's home-court advantage at Burr Gymnasium, where the Bison boast a 70% win rate in non-conference games, offsetting UMBC's edge in perimeter shooting led by guard guard Bryce Johnson averaging 18 points lately. No major injuries reported on official updates, but watch Howard's star forward Jordan Hairston, questionable with ankle tweak per beat reports—confirmation could swing odds 5-10 points toward UMBC, while a clear lineup tilts back to the hosts amid even pace-of-play metrics.
